During the assault on the TerraGroup office, a massive explosion erupted on top of one of the nearby high-rises. I got left on my own, with no contact with command. Looks like I'll have to handle the evacuation myself.

But first things first, I have to get out of this Ground Zero.

68cbdaac76fe74b1e80bfd98: The backup evacuation point is located at the port on the coast, but reaching it means moving straight through the city. In case of an emergency, command left us a few local contacts — people who know the routes and can help with supplies. To get through the city streets, I'll need help from a certain Therapist. She knows the safe approaches to the Streets of Tarkov, and without her intel, heading in would be too risky. She might also be a valuable contact down the line. I could also bypass the downtown area and head for the highway interchange that leads toward the port. But that area is under Ragman's watch. I’ll have to make arrangements with him first if I want to pass through. I can try working with Therapist and Ragman, and also make my way to the interchange.
